# Vendored Expo SecureStore package

`expo-secure-store-57.0.1.tgz` was produced with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` from
the official `expo/expo` repository at commit
`522549c7d4908bf8a9e3f5039544fd4acd5b4669`.

It is stored locally because the approved npm registry was unavailable during
T13 implementation. The package remains MIT-licensed and is used only to make
the native SecureStore module reproducibly available to clean installs.
